== frame implicit_cd cursor=1,22
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ a
|testuser@<HOST> ~/a $

@0 fg=1 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 a
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/a
